system.description:
An elven order of the Supreme Aldorethi Council, sworn to protect the Phoenix Prince Daeric Khyrmin.

  • The Ashes take elves, young, and erase who they were; a runaway of another people is the GM's call.
  • Most who take this kit fled the order, and the Ashes want them back.
  • Ghost Step: indoors or in a settled area, when you Hide and Move Silently together, only one of the two checks has Disadvantage. Your first Sneak Attack each encounter against a creature that can't see you is a critical hit on a 19 or 20.
    • 9th level: a critical hit on an 18 to 20.
  • Reconstructed Identity: Advantage on Disguise checks to impersonate an elf. An Aldorethi noble or Ashes operative who recognises you as a former member starts Hostile on the Reaction table.
